reason: This is a cross-cutting redesign of index-usage/statistics collection, not a local stats-only tweak. It changes executor hot paths (`adapter.go`, `point_get.go`), session/sessionctx interfaces and lifecycle, plus domain/config startup and stats handle code. Even without direct planner-rule edits, it can change cluster-wide statistics inputs and per-statement collection/sync behavior, which is central enough to hide High-severity issues such as bad stats propagation, session/runtime regressions, or hot-path overhead/locking mistakes.
